sections.title: Why women's health. ==Why now.==
text: Women's health is moving beyond reproductive health and consumer wellness.
It now reaches higher-acuity medicine: therapeutics, precision devices, diagnostics and specialty care. And strategic acquirers are looking for pipeline renewal where female biology matters.
sections.quote: "Kidron Capital was built to invest into this inflection point with specialist focus, disciplined healthcare diligence, and access across the US, Europe, and Israel."

sections.title: Why ==Kidron==
sections.lead: Specialist focus, healthcare investing experience, and cross-border access — in one platform.
left: We believe women's health requires a dedicated investment approach. The category spans complex clinical, regulatory, and commercial questions that are often not well served by generalist frameworks.

What distinguishes Kidron is not only our focus, but how we invest. We combine domain specialization with relationship-driven sourcing across key healthcare ecosystems — giving us access to differentiated opportunities across multiple modalities and stages of maturity.

Fund I has helped validate this approach. As we build Fund II, we are applying those lessons with greater ownership concentration, stronger follow-on capacity, and a continued focus on companies with clear value-creation pathways and strong return potential.

aside.title: ==Specialist== focus
aside.text: A dedicated women's health lens — not a generalist framework. We go deep where others stay broad.

aside.title: ==Biology-first== Underwriting
aside.text: We start with the clinical question — where does female biology create a differentiated product, stronger adoption logic, or overlooked market opportunity.

aside.title: ==Cross-border== access
aside.text: Active networks across US, Europe, and Israel — three of the world's most dynamic healthcare ecosystems.

sections.title: Our investment approach
sections.intro: We invest with a specialist lens across the full spectrum of women's health.

items.title: A disciplined view of women's health
items.text: We invest across conditions unique to women, diseases that affect women differently, and health needs that disproportionately impact women — broad enough to capture major opportunities, but disciplined enough to remain clinically coherent.

items.title: Biology-first underwriting
items.text: We start with the underlying biology: where female physiology changes disease risk, diagnosis, progression, treatment response, or care delivery. This allows us to identify women's health opportunities that generalist healthcare investors may overlook.

items.title: Clinical and commercial rigor
items.text: We evaluate each opportunity through evidence, mechanism, regulatory pathway, intellectual property, reimbursement logic, adoption barriers, and strategic exit relevance — not through thematic enthusiasm alone.

items.title: Multiple modalities, one specialist lens
items.text: We invest across therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare services, and consumer health — with a consistent focus on scalable value creation.

items.title: Cross-border reach
items.text: With deep networks across the US, Europe, and Israel, we are positioned to source differentiated opportunities and support companies across major healthcare markets.

sections.title: Where our thesis ==comes to life==
sections.intro: We invest in companies addressing clinically important, commercially significant opportunities across women's health.

items.name: Portal
items.area: Improving chemotherapy access through better vascular port design
text: Rethinking vascular access in chemotherapy with a novel port designed to improve ease of placement while better addressing the needs of female patients.

items.name: May Health
items.area: Restoring ovulation in women with PCOS
text: A breakthrough approach aimed at restoring ovulation in women with PCOS, one of the most common endocrine conditions affecting women of reproductive age.

items.name: CardioRenal Systems
items.area: Reducing AKI risk after cardiac surgery
text: The only clinically validated solution addressing elevated AKI risk in women undergoing cardiac surgery — commercially active in Saudi Arabia and Europe.

items.name: Beyond Medicine — developer of Rebel Cell
items.area: Targeting mitochondrial dysfunction in skin aging
text: Leveraging clinically demonstrated insights into age-related mitochondrial dysfunction for new approaches in skin rejuvenation and longevity.

items.name: Nua Surgical
items.area: Advancing maternal health in C-section care
text: A novel self-retaining surgical retractor designed for C-sections, addressing the procedural needs of one of the most common surgeries in the world.
items.investors: EQT Life Sciences, TX Medical Center

items.name: PregnanTech
text: Developing LIONESS™ — a device to prevent preterm birth by supporting the cervix through a minimally invasive outpatient procedure.

sections.title: General Partners
intro: A cross-border GP team built for women's health investing

Kidron is led by two healthcare investors with presence across Silicon Valley, Boston, Tel Aviv, Europe, and Israel. Together, the GPs combine women's health specialization, clinical and scientific diligence, venture investing, fund formation, transaction experience, and active portfolio governance.
sections.outro: Together, the GPs combine scientific diligence, venture judgment, cross-border sourcing, and active portfolio support across the women's health ecosystem.

items.name: Dr. Anula Jayasuriya
bio: Physician-investor with decades of experience across healthcare, life sciences, and venture capital. Founding Managing Partner of EXXclaim Capital and Evolvence India Life Science Fund I and II. Former VP at Roche Pharmaceuticals. Led investments including nVision Medical (acquired by Boston Scientific). Co-founded Artemis Women's Health Foundation. Vice Chair of WHAM.
**Board:** Jaguar Health NASDAQ, Lineage Cell Therapeutics, Aarvik, Solera Bio, Nua Surgical.

items.name: Maria Gajda Horowitz
bio: 15+ years in healthcare venture: portfolio construction, capital strategy, and investor relations. Active in VC investments since 2011, working across Europe and Israel on fund structuring, investment negotiations, healthcare asset acquisitions, and public market transactions.
**Board:** Beyond Medicine Inc., CardioRenal Systems Inc. **Observer:** Portal Access.

items.q: What does Fund II invest in?
items.a: Early-stage companies across therapeutics, medical devices, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare services and consumer health, where female biology changes risk, diagnosis, treatment or care.
Across the US, Europe and Israel, through the partners' networks in Silicon Valley, Boston, Tel Aviv and Europe.
